nodes.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks, foundation models, and autonomous intelligent systems; the primary shelf whenever an excerpt is about AI but establishes no child shelf's subject.
exclude: traditional non-AI software development
general business operations
unrelated science and hardware
include: AI content that mentions models, companies, products or purchases without establishing a child shelf's subject (generic model task-fit, inference hardware throughput, assistant capabilities in general)
nodes.name: AI and ML

nodes.definition: Clips and commentary reporting or discussing real-world breaking incidents, crimes, armed conflicts, and political or social debates shared via social media and news broadcasts.
exclude: discussion of an AI/tech product or capability -> AI and ML
an AI agent or model demonstrated performing a task -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
AI company business, market, or competitive commentary -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
include: breaking reports naming a specific crime, riot, or armed-conflict incident (takes precedence over every AI and ML shelf when the incident, not a product or model, is the subject)
raw police/military radio or scanner audio captured during an unfolding event
political or cultural opinion segments from talk shows or panels
nodes.name: News and Current Events

nodes.definition: Space exploration, astronautics, astrophysics, orbital mechanics, planetary science, and empirical scientific inquiry.
exclude: commercial airline aviation
science fiction and fantasy entertainment
general consumer technology
nodes.name: Space and Science

nodes.definition: AI agent and assistant products that act for a user or business: agents that autonomously execute multi-step real-world tasks or business workflows, sensing and acting companions that see, hear, remember and respond like a coworker or friend, and proposed persistent assistants that continuously watch a user's screen or meetings.
exclude: coding-specific agent harnesses, IDE tools, or SDKs for software engineers -> AI and ML / Developer Tools
model architecture or benchmark evaluation without a shown agent or assistant acting for a user -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
a finished generated video, image, or film shown as creative output -> AI and ML / Generative Media
company market position, revenue, funding, or rivalry commentary without a product acting for a user -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
technical AI safety or security controls, including monitoring to detect prompt injection or enforce runtime guardrails -> AI and ML / Security
include: companion or assistant product described as sensing, hearing, acting, remembering and understanding the user like a coworker or friend

agent completes multi-step real-world tasks end-to-end (booking, shopping, research) without step-by-step direction (takes precedence over AI and ML / Developer Tools when the user is not doing software engineering)
AI agents autonomously running full business functions (sales, underwriting, coaching) without human operators
agent-driven workflow where agents autonomously plan, execute, and deliver on a stated goal

proposed persistent assistant that continuously watches the user's screen or meetings for personal assistance, rather than technical safety or security control (takes precedence over AI and ML / Security for this personal-assistance case)
nodes.name: AI Agents and Automation

nodes.definition: News and commentary on the AI industry's competitive, financial, and policy dynamics, including company rivalries, revenue and market share, government restrictions on AI companies, and market/usage economics.
exclude: technical model architecture, benchmarks, or capability evaluation -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent product demonstrating task execution itself -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
a finished AI-generated creative artifact shown as the output -> AI and ML / Generative Media
coding-tool usage or IDE/SDK workflow steps -> AI and ML / Developer Tools
technical safety, sandboxing, prompt-injection or jailbreak defenses -> AI and ML / Security
model scaling, post-training or training pipelines as the dominant subject, with economics secondary -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
a company name or acquisition mentioned in passing while the excerpt's subject is hardware throughput or a capability with no business analysis -> AI and ML
include: executive or public figure names who is winning the AI competitive race
government policy or restriction reported as affecting an AI company's competitive position (takes precedence over AI and ML / Security, which covers technical safety and guardrails)
commentary that a company now faces real competition in the AI market
industry-wide analysis of usage share versus revenue capture between open and closed AI providers
reported revenue or annual recurring revenue (ARR) figures for an AI company
AI's effect on enterprise adoption, labour, task economics or economic growth as the subject
AI accelerator or chip competition and its implications for chip and model companies
nodes.name: AI Industry and Business

nodes.definition: Software engineering tooling as the subject: agent harnesses, IDE extensions, coding assistants, SDKs, and developer-focused workflows, described as products, capabilities, comparisons or workflows rather than taught.
exclude: a tutorial, workshop or lecture whose purpose is to teach, even when it uses a developer tool -> AI and ML / Education
personal assistant or agent acting for a non-engineer user (speech, screen or task help) -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
generic model comparison or model task-fit talk with no coding task, SDK or IDE -> AI and ML
consumer conversational chatbots
pure theoretical ML papers without tools
non-technical end-user products
nodes.name: Developer Tools

nodes.definition: Lectures, pedagogical explanations, conceptual deep dives, tutorials, workshops and step-by-step walkthroughs whose purpose is to teach machine learning or how to build with AI, even when they use or name a specific tool, model or product.
exclude: product announcements and release notes for a tool or model, with no teaching purpose -> AI and ML / Developer Tools or AI and ML / Frontier Models
marketing keynotes
opinion pieces without pedagogical content
include: hands-on tutorial, workshop or walkthrough that builds or explains something step by step (takes precedence over AI and ML / Developer Tools and AI and ML / Frontier Models when the excerpt's purpose is to teach)

conceptual explanation of how a technique, architecture or orchestration pattern works, with examples (takes precedence over AI and ML / Developer Tools and AI and ML / Frontier Models when the excerpt's purpose is to teach)
nodes.name: Education

nodes.definition: Architectures, capability evaluations, multimodal systems, scaling behavior, and releases of frontier foundation models.
exclude: a tutorial, workshop, lecture or conceptual explanation whose purpose is to teach, even when it discusses a specific model, architecture or capability evaluation -> AI and ML / Education
generic talk that different models suit different tasks, with no architecture, evaluation or release -> AI and ML
enterprise adoption, labour or task economics, or accelerator competition as the dominant subject -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
routine fine-tuning on niche tasks
end-user application tutorials
general AI business news
include: model scaling, post-training and training-pipeline discussion as the dominant subject (takes precedence over AI and ML / AI Industry and Business when economics is secondary)
nodes.name: Frontier Models

nodes.definition: AI systems and products whose demonstrated output is a finished visual creative artifact -- animation, film, or image/video-generated website -- produced from prompts or automated pipelines.
exclude: release coverage whose excerpt centers on architecture, scaling or benchmarks without a finished generated artifact -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent autonomously completing a real-world non-creative task -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
company market position or revenue commentary -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
a coding/SDK workflow used to build the artifact rather than the artifact itself -> AI and ML / Developer Tools
include: prompt-driven 3D or claymation-style animation generated as the shown output
an AI-generated short film entered in or winning an AI-specific film award
an AI animated film premiered at a creative or computer-graphics industry event
AI image/video generation models used to build a visual website shown as the output
AI-generated video content praised firsthand for its entertainment or creative quality
a foundation-model release whose excerpt centers on a finished generated visual artifact (takes precedence over AI and ML / Frontier Models)
nodes.name: Generative Media

nodes.definition: AI safety, cybersecurity, agent sandboxing, prompt injection defenses, vulnerability analysis, and governance guardrails.
exclude: generic network security without AI component
routine software bug reports
corporate compliance without technical safety
include: AI safety risk, catastrophic-outcome or existential-risk warnings as the subject (takes precedence over the AI and ML parent)
nodes.name: Security

nodes.definition: Rocket propulsion, orbital spaceflight missions, spacecraft operations, astronaut activities, and commercial launch systems.
exclude: terrestrial astronomy without launch systems
atmospheric aeronautics
speculative science fiction
nodes.name: Spaceflight
